svg.title: Waggle Dance — natural honeybee sequence
svg.desc: Approved naturalistic concept, cotton knit in cornflower blue. Four thread colors. Fine continuous dance trail replaces isolated concept dashes. Recalculate stitches and audit encoded PES after any edit.
